title: Chemical short-range order increases the phonon heat conductivity in a refractory high-entropy alloy

recollection.intervention: guess: thermal treatment or alloy composition modification
recollection.structure: guess: crystalline solid solution with chemical short-range order
recollection.mechanism: guess: increased phonon mean free path due to reduced lattice distortion
recollection.results: guess: increased thermal conductivity measured experimentally

score.note: The proposed thermal treatment or composition change does not match the Monte Carlo-induced variation of SRO. The structural description merely restates generic SRO and misses B2-like HfTi/TiZr clusters and percolation pathways. Reduced lattice distortion and increased phonon mean free path correctly capture part of the mechanism, but the percolative pathways and phonon-DOS changes are omitted. No ~12% value is recalled, and the claim of experimental measurement is incorrect.
